name: kill_rewards
description: FFX-2 live build 25501027: the kill-reward routine, run in the ffxparity emulator on the real machine code with the random generator scripted: the item function (0x00624890; the 60,000-vector proof), the reward roll with its per-owner modifiers (0x006246d0 with 0x006244c0; 60,000 vectors, the AP gain recorded) and the AP gain (0x00635590; 40,000 vectors, the spending and the stats refresh recorded). A stratified pick of the vectors that matched the note's independent Python models with no difference (FFX2-G03). Results are {exp, gil, rec: [[exp at start, exp gained]], cnt, ids, qty}; "rngDraws" are the raw 31-bit values the game drew, stream 10 then (when an item dropped) stream 11.
